description: Large pothole on Sector 4 Main Road near the City Market bus stop. Two-wheelers are swerving to avoid it and it gets worse after rain.
location: Sector 4 Main Road, near City Market

description: Garbage bins have been overflowing outside Greenview Apartments for a week. Bad smell and stray dogs are spreading the waste across the lane.
Streetlight not working near the Government School gate. The road is completely dark in the evening and children return from tuition at this time.
Water pipe burst near the Ward 7 community hall. Clean water has been flowing onto the road for two days and the street is waterlogged.
Deep pothole on the highway service road near the Railway Station crossing. A scooter fell here last night and the rider was hurt.
location: Highway service road, Railway Station crossing

description: Streetlight flickering and buzzing on Civil Lines Road for several days. Exposed wiring is visible at the base of the pole.
Garbage dumped on the empty plot behind the Sabzi Mandi. It has not been cleared for many days and there is a foul stench.
Small water leakage from the main pipeline joint at the Temple Street corner. Water is dripping continuously, wasting a lot of water.
Pothole near the petrol pump on Ring Road has been repaired badly and the patch has cracked again.
Dustbin near the public park gate is full and waste is scattered around. Please arrange regular collection.
Street light is broken on the footbridge stairs near the Metro station entrance. It is very dark and unsafe for pedestrians at night.
Sewage water is overflowing from the drain in front of the clinic on Nehru Colony Road. Contaminated water is blocking the entrance.
location: Nehru Colony Road, in front of clinic

description: Loud construction noise continues past midnight at a site on Garden Avenue. Please check permission timings.
Road surface has many cracks and small potholes along the stretch outside Sunrise Public School.
location: Outside Sunrise Public School, Station Road
